name: panel-reveal
title: Panel Reveal
description: A panel reveal primitive with height expansion and content fade

variables.label: Title
variables.description: The header line that sits above the folded body.

variables.label: Width
variables.description: How wide the panel sits, 280, 360 or 480 px.

variables.label: Tone
variables.description: Surface family: paper is the white card for light frames, ink inverts it for dark frames.

variables.label: Reveal
variables.description: Whether the body fades in with the height. fade is the shipped motion, solid opens the height only.
